description: Electricité de Guinée maintains a public annual-report archive. The listing identifies recent 2025, 2024 and 2023 reports and older editions with separate access links. For simulation it supplies a provider source for annual system and organisational context. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers the EDG annual-report series.
